properties.notes: Conversion of ground and mezzanine floor from bank (Class A2) to restaurant and bar (Class A3/A4) with associated kitchens, storage and plant at basement level. Conversion of first to third floors from offices (Class B1) to 12 flats (Class C3) flats with associated gym, cycle storage, and refuse storage in basement. Erection of extension to house extended fire escape, erection of 4 dormers windows and provision of roof terrace and lobby and provision of extract and ventilation
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
